svg.title: I sequence and charge map
svg.text: I · full sequence & side-chain charge classes
Enterobacteria phage M13 · M13p09 · residues 1–348 of 348 · topology bands: Phobius, DeepTMHMM, TOPCONS2
H — variable protonation (not treated as fixed charge)
A/V/I/L/M/F/W/Y — declared hydrophobic/aromatic class (not a hydropathy prediction)
Approximate side-chain classes near neutral pH — not measured charges, net charge, pI or electrostatics.
Local environment and pH shift protonation; termini are not modeled. Charge colouring does not prove orientation.
